result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. The horizontally scrollable category chips and restaurant carousel with edge-clipped items, as well as the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport, are intended features and not reported. One minor content issue was found: a typo in the search placeholder text.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
